findings.summary: Partial-write rollback behavior is claimed but untested and unimplemented
findings.details: S05-T01 explicitly requires failure-first proof that a partial capture transaction failure leaves no orphan receipt, revision, artifact, or processing job. The delivered source-ledger proof stops at pure schema/key validation and in-memory duplicate checks, while the lifecycle document asserts transaction-fenced failed inserts. Without a focused rollback test at the ledger write boundary, this can false-green even if a future capture path writes one ledger row before failing another.
